bugs.title: archive() throws when the resource does not exist
stepsToReproduce: Call archive() with an id that is not in the database
bugs.expectedBehavior: A not-found error is returned to the caller
bugs.actualBehavior: TypeError: cannot read property 'status' of null

bugs.title: Any authenticated user can archive any tenant's resource
stepsToReproduce: POST /resources/{id}/archive with an id owned by another tenant
bugs.suspectedCause: The controller uses req.params.id without checking ownership.
